# AEE

### Advanced Environment Extension — physically accurate environment simulation for Arma 3

- Elevation lapse rates and diurnal temperature cycles, terrain microclimate, true air density.
- Thermal and physiological effects, optics, mobility, maritime state, radio propagation, atmospheric events.
- Standalone: requires only CBA_A3. Deterministic across machines.

::: {.features}

::: {.feature}
### Atmosphere
Pressure, humidity, wind, fog, clouds, turbulence, icing, lightning, microbursts, and pressure trends.

::: {.learn-more}
[Module reference »](chapters/modules.qmd#sec-modules)
:::
:::

::: {.feature}
### Temperature
Solar-elevation diurnal model, lapse rate, surface effects, wind chill, heat index, WBGT, water temperature, and thermal crossover.

::: {.learn-more}
[Physics »](chapters/physics.qmd#sec-physics)
:::
:::

::: {.feature}
### Ballistics
True air density from temperature, pressure, and humidity, with crosswind and Coriolis deflection.

::: {.learn-more}
[Formulas »](annexes/annex-a-formulas.qmd#sec-annex-a)
:::
:::

::: {.feature}
### Optics
Glare, mirage, thermal contrast, rain and dew on optics, snow blindness, heat shimmer, and atmospheric seeing.

::: {.learn-more}
[Module reference »](chapters/modules.qmd#sec-modules)
:::
:::

::: {.feature}
### Mobility
Engine derating, helicopter lift, traction, mud accretion, soil bearing strength, and route degradation.

::: {.learn-more}
[Module reference »](chapters/modules.qmd#sec-modules)
:::
:::

::: {.feature}
### Maritime
Sea state on the Beaufort scale, wave height, tides, and compass deviation.

::: {.learn-more}
[Module reference »](chapters/modules.qmd#sec-modules)
:::
:::

::: {.feature}
### Physiology
UV index, heat acclimatisation, dehydration, battery derating, scent dispersion, and altitude adaptation.

::: {.learn-more}
[Module reference »](chapters/modules.qmd#sec-modules)
:::
:::

::: {.feature}
### Radio
VHF, UHF, and HF propagation under atmospheric conditions.

::: {.learn-more}
[Module reference »](chapters/modules.qmd#sec-modules)
:::
:::

::: {.feature}
### Environment
Koppen biomes, seasonal foliage, snow, crop and fire risk, floods, avalanches, dust, CBRN persistence, and lunar illumination.

::: {.learn-more}
[Module reference »](chapters/modules.qmd#sec-modules)
:::
:::

:::
:::

::: {.content-block .py-4}
::: {.facts}

- **Standalone** — requires only CBA_A3.
- **Deterministic** — the same state on every machine.
- **50 shared** `aee_core_*` state variables.
- **18 addons**, 5 optional host-mod compatibility layers.
- **Version 1.0.0** — GPL-2.0-or-later with a PBO-distribution exception.

:::
:::
